query: Draft a case study for Redondo Beach USD for MCR-264. I have interview notes saying they cut scheduling admin time about 60%, recovered roughly $180K in rental revenue, and now manage 22 facilities through Facilitron Works.
expected_behavior: Pulls available inputs (Jira ticket via acli, any Confluence brief via tron:confluence) and treats the quantified Results metrics as the spine of the draft
Uses AskUserQuestion to secure the 3-4 headline metrics and an attributable customer pull-quote (speaker plus title) before drafting, rather than opening with an empty Results block
Structures the draft in the Facilitron house format: Header, Challenge, Solution, Results (with metrics + pull-quote), Looking ahead
Produces a markdown draft at a draft path (e.g. /tmp/content/<slug>-case-study.md) with a front-matter stub including title, summary, customer, and metrics
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice), leads with the outcome, backs every claim with a metric or quote, and flags genuinely missing facts with > TODO: rather than inventing them
Stays git-free (does not branch, commit, or write to the content tree) and offers handoff to tron:guide-item / tron:news-item or tron:md-to-pdf, confirming before any publish step
